2105-5895-6791-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-6791-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-6791-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2790-6558.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2790-6558.notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
2790-6558.description:
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter's ability targeting Angel of Destiny by paying {2}{U} and exiling it from your graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature and making each other creature you control become a copy of it until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

4770-5301-6723-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-5223-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5223-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6754-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-6754-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-4871-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

465-728-2150.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2757-3129-5285.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

4365-6441-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Mondrak and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
4365-6441-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1115-2034-4289-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-2313.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Conclave Mentor
Repeat.

3129-3510-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3129-3510-5702.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4268-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4268-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
4268-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

423-1362-1437-2248--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1362-1437-2248--85.description:
Cast Skyshroud Ranger by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Skyshroud Ranger spell three times.
Resolve the first Skyshroud Ranger copy.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering Evolution Sage.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4681-5170-7286.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

465-5147-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4091-4885-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4359-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4050-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-6719.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ley Weaver with "Elf" chosen

573-1399-1606-7040.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1651-5921-6754-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-5921-6754-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-5921-6754-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1322-1329-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
392-3532-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the Uthros Research Craft trigger, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1762-5173-5231-5626.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {R}.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-4865--39.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Shapeshifter is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-4865--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

2060-4222-4929-5462.manaNeeded: {6} available plus an additional {1} if you have no colored mana
2060-4222-4929-5462.notablePrerequisites: Raucous Entertainer does not have summoning sickness.
2060-4222-4929-5462.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, using at least one colored mana if available.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {2}.
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Raucous Entertainer by paying {1} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler, Cryptic Trilobite and any other creature you control the entered the battlefield this turn.
If you have no {C} in your mana pool, activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Raucous Entertainer.
Repeat from step 4.

3368-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are three permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
3368-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {9}{G}{U}, targeting the three mana-producing permanents.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, copying Doppelgang targeting the three mana-producing permanents, and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating three token copies of the three targeted permanents.
Activate six of the permanent copies by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite copies of the targeted permanents and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using the Doppelgang copies.
You may also repeatedly cast Reiterate to copy any other instant or sorcery spells on the stack, or any that would enter the stack.

141-2091-4499.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three tapped lands.
141-2091-4499.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Mana Geyser.
Resolve the copy of Mana Geyser, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control four or more tapped lands, this combo nets infinite red mana.

1409-1494-3021.manaNeeded: {1}{U} during the first turn, and every three turns afterwards
1409-1494-3021.notablePrerequisites:
Sage of Hours does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Conclave Sledge-Captain.
1409-1494-3021.description:
Activate Conclave Sledge-Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Conclave Sledge-Captain enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers three times, all targeting Sage of Hours, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repariing it and Conclave Sledge-Captain.
Resolve all Conclave Sledge-Captain triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours, and causing it to gain the printed abilities three times until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Sage of Hours, triggering its abilities granted by Conclave Sledge-Captain three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours for each damage it dealt.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least three extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

3000-4385-5231.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Sliver and Squirrel, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

317-2034-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
317-2034-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and +1/+1 counters, you may stop sacrificing the Saprolings to get infinite creature tokens.

394-3029-4050-4408.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Merfolk Secretkeeper, adding {U}.
Cast Venture Deeper for its flashback cost by paying {U}, causing target player to mill four cards, then exile Merfolk Secretkeeper.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bat token, adding {U}.
Cast Merfolk Secretkeeper from exile by paying {U}.
Repeat.
